llamacpp_env.title: Environment variables
llamacpp_env.description: Environment variables for llama.cpp (KEY=VALUE), separated by ';'

extra_args.title: Additional arguments
extra_args.description: Extra llama-server options, e.g. --rope-scaling yarn --no-warmup. Applied to every model and written after the settings above, so they win. Server address, credentials and model file options are ignored.

models_max.title: Max Concurrently Loaded Models
models_max.description: Maximum number of models the router will keep loaded at once. 0 = unlimited.

idle_unload_minutes.title: Unload Idle Models After (minutes)
idle_unload_minutes.description: Unload a local model that has not been used for this many minutes, to free memory. It reloads on the next request. Embedding models and models with a request in progress are never unloaded. 0 = never. Default 30, so VRAM is not held while you game or render.

timeout.title: Timeout for llamacpp
timeout.description: Llamacpp connection and load timeout in seconds

ctx_size.title: Default context size
ctx_size.description: The context window used for local models that do not set their own. Larger = remembers more but needs more memory. Each model can override this in its own settings (gear icon). Leave on Auto to use the model's native size (can be huge). Common sizes: 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 65536, 131072.

fit.title: Auto-fit
fit.description: Let Flint decide how many layers run on the GPU and how large the context can be, so the model fits in your memory. Turn it off to set GPU layers and Context Size yourself.

fit_target.title: Auto-fit: memory to keep free
fit_target.description: How much memory (in MiB) auto-fit leaves free on each GPU for other apps and the display. Lower it (for example 256) to let models use more of your VRAM, or raise it if your system gets sluggish while a model is loaded. It is taken from the memory the GPU reports as free, so a card shows less than its full size when other apps hold some. Each load writes the size and free memory of every GPU to the log. Local models only.

fit_ctx.title: Auto-fit: smallest context
fit_ctx.description: The smallest context size (in tokens) auto-fit may shrink to when the model does not fit in memory. It never goes below this, and the model fails to load if it still does not fit. This is not the context size: set that in Default context size or per model in Context Size. Only used while Auto-fit is on, and only for local models.

threads.title: Threads
threads.description: Number of threads to use during generation (-1 for logical cores).

threads_batch.title: Threads (Batch)
threads_batch.description: Number of threads for batch and prompt processing (default: same as Threads).

ctx_shift.title: Context Shift
ctx_shift.description: Allow model to cut text in the beginning to accommodate new text in its memory

n_predict.title: Max Tokens to Predict
n_predict.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate (-1 = infinity).

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Logical maximum batch size for processing prompts.

ubatch_size.title: uBatch Size
ubatch_size.description: Physical maximum batch size for processing prompts. 0 = auto: 1024 when the model fits in VRAM with room to spare, 512 when it is tight, 2048 when it spills to system RAM.

n_cpu_moe.title: MoE Layers on CPU
n_cpu_moe.description: Keep the Mixture-of-Experts weights of the first N layers in CPU memory. Lets a large MoE model fit in limited VRAM. 0 disables it.

n_cpu_ffn.title: Dense FFN Layers on CPU
n_cpu_ffn.description: Keep the dense feed-forward weights of the first N layers in CPU memory. The counterpart of the MoE setting above, for dense models. 0 disables it.

no_kv_offload.title: Disable KV Cache Offload
no_kv_offload.description: Keep the KV cache in system RAM instead of GPU memory. Useful when VRAM is scarce, at the cost of speed.

device.title: Devices for Offload
device.description: Comma-separated accelerators to offload to, named as in the detected hardware list. Leave empty to use every available accelerator, or set "none" to disable offload entirely.

split_mode.title: GPU Split Mode
split_mode.description: How to split the model across multiple GPUs.

main_gpu.title: Main GPU Index
main_gpu.description: The GPU to use for the model (split-mode=none) or intermediate results (split-mode=row).

tensor_split.title: Tensor Split
tensor_split.description: Comma-separated proportions for splitting the model across devices, e.g. "3,1". Leave empty for an even split.

no_op_offload.title: Disable Op Offload
no_op_offload.description: Keep host tensor operations on the CPU instead of offloading them to the accelerator.

flash_attn.title: Flash Attention
flash_attn.description: Enable Flash Attention for optimized performance.

parallel.title: Parallel Sequences
parallel.description: Number of parallel sequences to decode for your own chat requests (0 = llama.cpp default of 4). Flint reserves one additional internal slot beyond this for background requests (e.g. thread auto-titling), so they don't evict your chat's KV cache.

reserve_background_slots.title: Reserve Background Slots
reserve_background_slots.description: Keep two extra internal slots beyond Parallel Sequences for background requests (thread auto-titling, Cowork, subagents) so they do not evict your chat's KV cache. Turn off to run exactly Parallel Sequences slots (set it to 1 for a single slot); background requests then share your chat's slot and can evict its cache. Reloads the model.

agent_slots.title: Agent Slots
agent_slots.description: Extra slots for subagents, workflow agents and other requests that name no slot, so parallel agents do not evict your chat's or Cowork's KV cache. They share one KV pool, so a slot costs little memory (hybrid models also keep recurrent state per slot). 0 turns them off. Needs Reserve Background Slots on. Reloads the model.

ngram_speculation.title: N-gram Speculative Decoding
ngram_speculation.description: Draft tokens from text already in the conversation (ngram-mod) and let the model verify them in one batch. Output is identical; repetitive output such as code edits or quoting generates 3-10x faster, other text is unaffected. Models with their own MTP draft use that instead.

cont_batching.title: Continuous Batching
cont_batching.description: Enable continuous batching (a.k.a dynamic batching) for concurrent requests. Enabled by default, matching llama.cpp.

no_mmap.title: Disable mmap
no_mmap.description: Do not memory-map model (slower load but may reduce pageouts if not using mlock).

lazy_mode.title: Lazy Tensor Reading
lazy_mode.description: Read the rows of large arch-marked tensors (e.g. per-layer embeddings) from disk on demand instead of keeping them in memory. Auto applies it above 4 GiB. Requires mmap.

mlock.title: MLock
mlock.description: Lock the model in RAM so it is never swapped out. Combined with "Disable mmap" this loads the weights without mmap and then locks them.

cache_type_k.title: KV Cache K Type
cache_type_k.description: KV cache data type for Keys. Auto uses q8_0, which halves the cache at a negligible quality cost.

cache_type_v.title: KV Cache V Type
cache_type_v.description: KV cache data type for Values. Auto uses q8_0 when Flash Attention is On and f16 otherwise, since a quantized V cache needs Flash Attention. A model that fails to load with it is retried once with f16.

rope_scaling.title: RoPE Scaling Method
rope_scaling.description: RoPE frequency scaling method. "Model default" leaves it to the model; "None" explicitly disables scaling.

rope_freq_base.title: RoPE Frequency Base
rope_freq_base.description: RoPE base frequency (0 = loaded from model).

rope_freq_scale.title: RoPE Frequency Scale Factor
rope_freq_scale.description: RoPE frequency scaling factor. 0 loads the value from the model; 1 forces no scaling.

cache_ram.title: Prompt Cache RAM (MiB)
cache_ram.description: Prompt cache size in MiB: the RAM that keeps other conversations' context so switching back to one does not re-read it. Blank or -2 = automatic from your RAM (20% of system RAM, at most half of what is free, 1024-8192); 0 = off; -1 = unlimited.

persist_thread_cache.title: Remember Conversations Between Sessions
persist_thread_cache.description: Keep each conversation's prompt cache on disk so reopening it does not re-read the whole conversation. Restored only when the model, its settings and the llama.cpp build all match what saved it.

thread_cache_size.title: Conversation Cache Disk Limit (MiB)
thread_cache_size.description: Disk budget for saved conversation caches (default: 2048). The oldest are dropped first once it is reached. One long conversation can take hundreds of MiB.

cache_reuse.title: Cache Reuse
cache_reuse.description: Min chunk size of matching prefix tokens to reuse from cache. 0 = disabled.

ctx_checkpoints.title: Context Checkpoints
ctx_checkpoints.description: Maximum context checkpoints kept per slot, which let a shifted context be restored instead of reprocessed.

checkpoint_min_step.title: Checkpoint Minimum Step
checkpoint_min_step.description: Minimum number of tokens between context checkpoints.

swa_full.title: Full SWA Cache
swa_full.description: Use full-size KV cache for sliding-window-attention models (e.g. Gemma). Enable this if such a model reprocesses the entire prompt every turn instead of reusing cache; costs more memory.

kv_unified.title: Unified KV Cache
kv_unified.description: Use a single unified KV buffer shared across all slots. Saves memory when running multiple parallel slots.

kv_unified_per_slot.title: Context Per Slot
kv_unified_per_slot.description: Cap how much of the unified KV cache one slot may use, in tokens. 0 leaves a slot free to fill the whole cache. Only applies when the cache is unified.

reasoning_preserve.title: Preserve Reasoning History
reasoning_preserve.description: Keep the reasoning of every earlier assistant turn in the prompt, not just the most recent one. Only affects models whose chat template supports it, and costs prompt tokens.

keep.title: Keep First N Tokens
keep.description: Number of tokens from the initial prompt to keep when context is shifted. -1 = keep all.
